name: caret-ui
description: Stub manifest so shadcn-svelte's CLI (which reads a package.json beside components.json) resolves from ui/. The real manifest is the repo-root package.json and deps live there, so run: bunx shadcn-svelte@latest add <name> --no-deps. `type: module` mirrors the root so files under ui/ stay ESM. See doc/agents/shadcn-rules.md.
